title: Custom Tesla Model S Vinyl Wrap
description: We installed the Tesla Model S vinyl wrap, enhancing its sleek design and making a bold statement on the road. For more information, check out our blog!

blocks.text: Custom Tesla Model S Vinyl Wrap

blocks.alt: A front view of a Tesla Model S with a custom matte finish vinyl wrap

blocks.html:
We created a stunning Tesla Model S vinyl wrap, enhancing its style and ensuring it captures attention on the road. This custom vinyl wrap not only elevates the vehicle’s appearance but also provides an additional layer of protection for the original paint. Below are the project details, materials used, and visuals showcasing this impressive transformation.

Highlights and key features of the Tesla Model S vinyl wrap project

Our designers printed custom branding on 1080 Series IJ 180 Printable Vinyl with a glossy finish.

We partnered with Vinyl Wrap Toronto for the installation.

Explore our car wraps to customize your vehicle; We offer both partial and full wrap services.

Reach out to us at Branding Centres to access our services.
